_comment: Copy this file to local_paths.json (git-ignored) and fill in the real values for each machine. Keys data_root, code_root and conda_setup may use ~ or be relative to the repo root. Delete profiles you do not use and add more freely. Resolution order: SEALSIM_<KEY> environment variable, then this file, then the default; see src/sealsim/config.py.

local.data_root: <absolute path to your sealsim results directory, e.g. /path/to/sealsim_results>

hpc.slurm_partition: <comma-separated GPU partitions your account may use>
